1.body:
Hello,

I saw your opening for the Graphic Designer role at Patni Toyota, and I was specifically drawn to the focus on developing in-showroom collateral and promotional materials that align with dealership brand guidelines.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I have designed over 100 digital and print creatives including banners, standees, certificates, and marketing collateral. Working closely with management stakeholders, I manage print-ready file production, bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy to ensure flawless execution across all print runs.

My branding kit for AT Creation startup, demonstrating logo, typography, and palette systems, can be viewed on my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I live in Nagpur and can easily come by your office for a brief conversation this week.

Ananya

Ananya Saini

2.body:
Hello,

I applied for the Product Designer role at AppExFlow because your team builds premium SaaS products where the interface itself drives the visual language.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I built reusable design systems and over 100 digital and print creatives that cut turnaround time for corporate communications. Earlier at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and translated user findings directly into interface wireframes and prototypes.

Bringing a Computer Science degree background, I also collaborate closely with developers to ensure smooth technical handoffs. My Bounceless case study demonstrates end to end B2B UX problem solving for email verification platforms, available in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Would you be open to taking a brief look at that project or hopping on a quick call this week?

Ananya
